notToBeConfusedWith.name: Ginger beer
notToBeConfusedWith.note: A stronger, spicier and traditionally fermented drink; bottled ginger ale is the paler, milder carbonated soda most mixed drinks that call for it actually mean.

forms.label: Bottled, commercial
forms.sourceNote: Beverages, carbonated, ginger ale. Public domain. The record's own cup portion is adopted as a true density because the drink is poured rather than packed. No titratable acidity is reported and no other source was checked, so acidPercent is left off rather than estimated.
